# Anubis

Strata's optional bot protection talks to [Anubis](https://github.com/TecharoHQ/anubis) by Techaro. Strata does not
contain Anubis and does not ship its program. On request, the dashboard downloads the release from github.com into the
instance's `.private/anubis/` together with Anubis' own licence file. This folder keeps the licence next to the code that
works with it, and the same notice goes with any copy of Anubis that is distributed together with Strata.

- `LICENSE`: the MIT licence of Anubis, copyright (c) 2025 Xe Iaso. Copied from the Anubis 1.28.1 release.
- The mascot images on Anubis' challenge page are by CELPHASE (https://bsky.app/profile/celphase.bsky.social) and,
  according to Anubis' own `ATTRIBUTIONS.txt`, are available under the same MIT licence.
- Anubis is credited under **Settings › About** in the dashboard and in the README.
